text:
nina: hitting a weird failure in eu-onprem-42 after last night's RBAC deploy. keystore-agent logs show wrapped-key lookup succeeded but KMS decrypt calls are 403. customer reports timeouts for some requests. @sam any quick ideas?

sam: 403 from KMS usually IAM or key policy. but if wrapped-key lookup worked, the agent probably had read access to secrets. can you paste the agent pod labels & SA?

nina: pod labels below, SA is `keystore-agent-sa.eu` (same as before).

jorge: fyi we rolled a change to the RBAC generator to default subjects when namespace is empty. I pushed that change to many clusters last night. Could be a templating fallback.

nina: looking at clusterrolebinding now: subject is `system:serviceaccount:keystore:keystore-agent-sa.eu` which is correct. but the cluster-level binding we expect to map the SA to an IAM role (IRSA) seems to have `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` annotation removed in the last kube-iam sync.

sam: run `kubectl -n keystore get serviceaccount keystore-agent-sa.eu -o yaml` and paste the annotations.

```
annotations:
  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::1234:role/keystore-agent-eu"
```

jorge: the sync job logs show a regression in the iam-sync tool where it drops annotations if `metadata.namespace` is null in the input manifest. We had a malformed CR in ops repo.

ci-bot: build #1023 for ops/iam-sync passed at 2026-03-20T23:40Z. The failing manifest lint was suppressed.

nina: so two problems: SA lost IRSA mapping on the node (so KMS call used node role which lacked kms:Decrypt) and audit logs from that time show no kms_key_id field.

sam: confirm: agent used node role? check `/var/run/secrets/eks.amazonaws.com/serviceaccount/token` env in the pod and instance metadata. If token missing, it's node role.

jorge: I pulled the node metadata: role is `node-role-worker-small` which does not include kms:Decrypt on the particular key. I found a recent PR that narrowed node role permissions. rolling back node role change will fix quickly but we should restore proper IRSA mapping.

nina: created short incident INC-2026-003-keystore-irsa-loss and started rollback.

sam: for audit: our cluster-audit policy was set to Metadata for secrets cluster-wide. We should add a rule for `keystore` namespace at RequestResponse to capture plugin annotations. Example quick patch:

```
- level: RequestResponse
  resources:
  - group: ""
    resources: ["secrets"]
  namespaces: ["keystore"]
```

jorge: also add a post-deploy gate in iam-sync CI to verify serviceaccount annotations are preserved. I'll open PR.

ci-bot: "PR #448 opened by jorge: iam-sync: validate SA annotations after sync"

nina: rollback done, node role reverted at 00:12Z, keystore-agent logs show Decrypt OK at 00:13Z. customer confirms degraded responses cleared.

sam: follow-ups: (1) add lint to RBAC generator to never default subject to empty namespace, (2) add CI test ensuring `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` survives iam-sync, (3) tweak audit-policy for keystore namespace, (4) create a runbook step to validate IRSA mapping after RBAC/iam-sync changes.

security-bot: Note: schedule a security review for the iam-sync changes and add a checklist item: "verify kms:Decrypt coverage for service accounts used by keystore agents".

nina: thanks. filing the post-incident tasks in INC-2026-003. closing thread unless anyone has objections. :white_check_mark:
